set_predictions.name: Set predictions
set_predictions.description: Overrides the consumption and/or production predictions the Proteus algorithm plans with. A quantity left out keeps the Proteus prediction. Plan recalculation runs in the background.

predictions.name: Predictions
predictions.description: List of hourly overrides. Every item needs time (start of the hour) and at least one of consumption_kwh or production_kwh. At most 96 unique hours.

clear_predictions.name: Clear predictions
clear_predictions.description: Removes prediction overrides so Proteus plans with its own predictions again. Plan recalculation runs in the background.

times.name: Times
times.description: List of hour starts whose overrides should be removed. At most 96 unique hours.

set_plan_steps.name: Set plan steps
set_plan_steps.description: Edit selected battery/PV plan hours for exactly one inverter. Other hours are preserved; the server locks earlier hours. Recalculation runs in the background.

steps.name: Steps
steps.description: List of time plus at least one of flexalgo_battery, flexalgo_pv, target_soc (0–100 or null), is_manually_locked. Omitted fields retain their current values.

clear_plan_steps.name: Clear plan steps
clear_plan_steps.description: Clear manual flags for selected hours of exactly one inverter. Later edited hours can keep earlier hours locked. Recalculation runs in the background.

times.name: Times
times.description: List of hour starts in the current plan.
